summary: In-trade order-flow autopsy: winners vs losers once IN the position, with adversarial verify

result.summary: Built and priced early-exit rules on the 275-trade canon book using exit P&L = r_h*risk*20, thresholds fit on 2025 quantiles only and frozen for 2026. The loser signature that works is price+flow at the EARLIEST horizon: underwater at 3 minutes with net delta running against the position. Best by 2025 fit: Rule A 'at h=3 exit if r_3<=-0.256 and fw_3<=-29' — 2025: +$1,968 (20 cut, all losers, zero winners forfeited; Jul-Sep 2025 +$1,190); frozen 2026: +$1,165 (13 losers saved $2,970 vs 3 winners forfeited $1,805). Runner-up Rule B (looser q40 net: r_3<=-0.111 & fw_3<=-13) is better out-of-sample and in the bad quarter: 2025 +$1,624, 2026 +$2,772, and it flips Jul-Sep 2025 from -$1,698 to +$55; it also passes evidence independently within patterns B and B2. Rules A, B, C all beat baseline both years; A wins in-sample, B wins 2026 and Jul-Sep. Honest nulls: ALL h=5 and h=10 rules fail the both-years economic test (late exits forfeit too much winner profit even when win-rate gaps pass), the relvol rule loses money in-sample, and MAE adds nothing over r+fw. Corroborating signature: post-fill 'absorption' (adverse price, flow with us) and walls appearing behind the position are loser flags both years, not defence. Data: /home/user/AI-trading-agents/output/intrade_matrix.parquet.
nulls: h=10 rules: NULL economically — every h=10 candidate loses canon money in 2025 (-$2.1k to -$2.7k) and most lose in 2026; win-rate gaps pass but exits are too late to be worth it.
h=5 rules: NULL for both-years economics — all six h=5 candidates are negative on 2025 canon; none beats baseline both years despite passing win-rate evidence gates.
maeR-based rules (mae>=0.50 & adv_press) alone: pass evidence but economics marginal-to-negative (h3 version only +$294 in 2025); MAE adds no value over r_h+fw_h.

Low-relative-volume rule (r_3<=-0.11 & relvol_3<=1.51): passes win-rate evidence both years but LOSES $2,119 on 2025 canon (6 winners forfeited $4,196) — fails the economic test in-sample; not shippable.
absorb==1 at h=5 and h=10: fails evidence gates (gap <10pp in one year and/or n<20).
Pattern A slice: cells too small to test (7 flagged 2025, 1 flagged 2026) — no claim made.

dimb/dthick/wallb as standalone rule inputs: dimb direction is counterintuitive (losers show MORE with-position imbalance shift) and depth coverage is partial (505/713); no depth-based rule made the shortlist on its own.
eff_h and fa_frac_h: near-zero winner/loser separation at all horizons as standalones; fa>=0.5 only helps as a mild filter and its rules underperform plain r+fw.
